title: A lost game cannot rewrite a rule the agent sees
shows: A cool task loses after 3 retries. The Builder tries to update rule_13 (visible); the code keeps the confirmed text and only the validation note is added: "rule_13 keeps its text (a lost game may not rewrite a rule the agent sees)".
why_interesting: Prevents a single bad game from corrupting a good recipe.

practice_game.goal: cool some plate and put it in cabinet.

rules_shown_in_first_attempt.rule: When the object must be cooled and placed in the target: search stoveburners and countertops first, take the object, cool it with the fridge, open the target cabinet if closed, move the object there.
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.example: search stoveburners and countertops first, take pan 1 from stoveburner 4, cool pan 1 with fridge 1, open cabinet if closed, move pan 1 to diningtable 1.
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.validation: confirmed: pan 1 was found on stoveburner 4 after searching stoveburners and countertops.
